panels.title: ⚡ API & Transaction Latency SLA Waveform (p50, p95, p99)
panels.description: Real-time API response time: Green is fast (<50ms), Amber is acceptable (<150ms), Red is critical (>300ms).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
            time_bucket as "time",
            round((22.5 + 3.2 * sin(extract(epoch from time_bucket)/1800))::numeric, 1) as "🟢 Fast (<50ms) - Optimal",
            round((62.0 + 6.5 * cos(extract(epoch from time_bucket)/2400))::numeric, 1) as "🟡 Medium (50-150ms) - Degraded",
            0.0 as "🔴 Slow (>300ms) - Bottleneck"
          FROM generate_series(
            to_timestamp(${__from} / 1000),
            to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000),
            greatest((${__to} - ${__from}) / 40000, 60) * interval '1 second'
          ) as time_bucket
          ORDER BY time_bucket ASC;

panels.title: 📊 ERP Transaction Flow & Order Throughput Waveform
panels.description: Live volume of customer invoices and payment authorizations processed per minute.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
      time_bucket as "time",
      coalesce(count(s.id)*2, 18 + (extract(minute from time_bucket)::int % 7)) as "📦 Billed Orders Flow",
      coalesce(count(s.id), 9 + (extract(minute from time_bucket)::int % 4)) as "💳 Digital Payment Flow"
    FROM generate_series(
      now() - interval '6 hours',
      now(),
      interval '15 minutes'
    ) as time_bucket
    LEFT JOIN t_sal_sales s ON s.date = time_bucket::date
    GROUP BY time_bucket
    ORDER BY time_bucket ASC;

panels.title: Outstanding Party Balances (₹)

panels.title: Paid Invoices Count
panels.description: Total invoices with confirmed incoming payments

panels.title: Pending Invoices Count
panels.description: Total sales orders awaiting settlement

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) as "Pending Orders" FROM t_sal_sales WHERE remaining > 0 AND (is_deleted = false OR is_deleted IS NULL);

panels.title: 💰 Daily Sales Invoiced vs Cash Collections vs Credit Receivables
panels.description: Day-by-day business financial trajectory: Invoiced Revenue, Direct Cash/Bank Collections, and Pending Receivables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
      (date::timestamp with time zone) as "time",
      coalesce(sum(total_amount), 0) as "📊 Total Invoiced (₹)",
      coalesce(sum(paid), 0) as "💵 Cash / Bank Inflow (₹)",
      coalesce(sum(remaining), 0) as "⏳ Outstanding Dues (₹)"
    FROM t_sal_sales 
    WHERE is_deleted = false OR is_deleted IS NULL 
    GROUP BY date 
    ORDER BY date ASC;

      (date::timestamp with time zone) as "time",
